spec_sections: DESIGN.md: main loop step 2; inherited development-feedback interface
SOURCE-IMPROVEMENT.md: development packet, original input binding and projected byte limits
PLAN.md: SRC-02 engineering prerequisite; scientific gates retained

behavior.builder: Passively verify caller-pinned complete screen, original C1/native custody and dedicated owner totals; return detached prospective records.
behavior.writer: Validate first; write NEW source/split/feedback/provenance files exclusively, retain failures and return refs only after checks.
behavior.projection: Explicit noveltybench-1.1 only; no official regrouping, utility recomputation or semantic critique.
behavior.omissions: Every original answer ordinal retains UTF8 hash/length and omitted bytes; quality/partition omissions explicit.
behavior.cost_scope: Original per-task generation and native owner totals, not shared-grant total.
behavior.generic_consumer: Existing CandidateSession accepts caller-reviewed notes; bridge/helper/provenance are not automatically enforced. Caller must bind exact inputs before execution.

focused_acceptance.scope: Separate cohorts at their recorded source pins, not a final combined 13-method run.
focused_acceptance.fixture_correction: Fake native emitter exceeded the existing 64KiB frame ceiling; one shared emitter now chunks literal artifacts, and its row transform occurs before emission. Production protocol guards unchanged.

typed_reader_regression.fix: Only add _Unsupported to existing candidate_generation shared error boundary/import.
green_boundaries: bridge after genuine inspection, third capture asserted
typed_reader_regression.red_result: Injected second-capture unsupported schema observation escapes public reader; failfast stopped before the bridge subtest.

focused_acceptance.candidate_session_scope: Construction/validation and worker-input projection only; zero new improver execution.

saved_synthetic_evidence.source_scope: Proof before the later typed-error/import and test-fixture changes; exact pins retained in its own record.
saved_synthetic_evidence.initial_checker_failure: First comparator used ensure_ascii=False rather than repository canonical JSON; retained failed harness and first new packet. No product defect or full post-bracket claimed for that attempt.

limits: No full final local repository suite; hosted final-head Linux/Windows pending.
No paid call, new actual allocation, key read or actual POL02 grant-state read.
No fresh improver execution, durable proposal controller, full inherited source-search loop, model-authored experiment or scientific improvement.
Earlier synthetic proof and scoped cohorts retain their actual source pins; resource ceilings are not maximum-size runtime guarantees.
POL-02 remains sole Next; SRC-02 remains In progress; seven major leaves remain.
